description: Optocoupler (optoisolator, photocoupler): a single package that couples an LED emitter to a photodetector across a galvanic-isolation barrier, transferring a signal while withstanding thousands of volts between input and output. The LED emitter is the family's necessary condition - it is what separates an optocoupler from a capacitive/magnetic DIGITAL ISOLATOR (ADuM/Si84xx/ISO7xxx, no LED, a separate future family). One dictionary spans every output architecture; a part populates the output block for its type and shares the LED-input group and the isolation-safety group with all others. Output types (discriminated by which output keys are present, plus the note-only OUTPUT condition axis): phototransistor (marquee current_transfer_ratio, a % ratio); photodarlington (same block, order-of-magnitude-higher CTR, slow switching); logic_gate / high-speed digital (6N137-class: NO CTR - the transfer is input_threshold_current + propagation delay, with output-side supply, logic levels, and often an enable pin); gate_drive (IGBT/MOSFET drivers: peak source/sink output_current, UVLO, output_on_resistance); linear (IL300/HCNR-class servo-photodiode: transfer_gain K3 = K2/K1, nonlinearity, gain tempco); photovoltaic MOSFET-driver (VOM1271: open_circuit_voltage + short_circuit_current, drives an EXTERNAL switch); and photo-triac_driver (MOC302x: led_trigger_current, off/on-state voltage, holding current, dv/dt - a TRIGGER device firing a bigger external triac). Out of scope as separate future families: solid_state_relay (integrated LOAD-CARRYING output switch - headline on_resistance / load current / load-voltage, not a coupler - e.g. CPC1017N, PVT/AQV); digital_isolator (capacitive/magnetic, no LED - ADuM/Si84xx/ISO7xxx); isolation_amplifier / isolated-ADC (analog-in to analog-out at a fixed gain with no user-visible LED/CTR transfer - HCPL-78xx, ACPL-C87x, AMC1200); and the discrete led / laser_diode / photodiode / phototransistor that are already their own families (an optocoupler is the barrier-crossing COMBINATION, not the discrete parts). Zero new units: CTR->% (or 1), all isolation ratings VISO/VIORM/VIOTM/VIOSM/VPR->V (the printed Vrms/Vpeak distinction carried by the measurement statistic field, not a unit), CMTI/dv/dt->V/us (kV/us x1e3), data_rate->Hz (MBd x1e6, binary NRZ), creepage/clearance/insulation->m, CTI->V, gain ratios K1/K2/K3->1, nonlinearity->%, gain tempco->ppm/degC, VF tempco->V/degC. Deliberate non-adds kept in conditionsVerbatim: partial-discharge charge (pC, a test-acceptance criterion - VPR in V is the device value), humidity %RH, and MBd (baud). Synthesized from a 20-datasheet corpus across Vishay, Broadcom (Avago/HP), Toshiba, Sharp, Everlight, Lite-On, and onsemi/Fairchild, spanning 4N35/PC817/EL817/TLP785 (phototransistor), 6N137/HCPL-2601/VO2611/TLP2361 (logic), HCPL-3120/ACNW3190/FOD3120/TLP350 (gate-drive), IL300/HCNR201 (linear), TLP627M (Darlington), MOC3021M (triac driver), and VOM1271 (photovoltaic).

parameters.name: LED forward voltage
parameters.hint: The LED's forward voltage at a stated drive current (typically IF = 10-20 mA), in volts. The one parameter universal to every optocoupler regardless of output type. Array over I_F when specified at several drive currents; attach the I_F condition. ~1.1-1.6 V for a GaAs/AlGaAs input LED.

parameters.name: Input forward current (abs max)
parameters.hint: The maximum continuous LED forward current, in amperes (a printed mA is 1e-3 A: 50 mA is 0.05). limitClass absolute_max. Derate above a stated ambient - keep the derating onset in conditionsVerbatim (the mA/degC slope is derivable, not stored).

parameters.name: Peak/pulsed forward current (abs max)
parameters.hint: The peak or pulsed LED current under a stated pulse width and duty, in amperes (1 A pulse is 1.0). limitClass absolute_max; attach the pulse width / duty as conditions or keep verbatim.

parameters.name: Input reverse voltage (abs max)
parameters.hint: The maximum reverse voltage across the input LED, in volts (typically 3-6 V). limitClass absolute_max.

parameters.name: Input reverse current
parameters.hint: The LED reverse leakage current at a stated reverse voltage, in amperes (a printed uA is 1e-6). Attach the V_R condition.

parameters.name: Input reverse breakdown voltage
parameters.hint: The LED reverse breakdown voltage (a min guarantee at a stated leakage, e.g. IR = 10 uA), in volts. Common on logic-output couplers; distinct from the absolute-max input_reverse_voltage.

parameters.name: Input (LED) capacitance
parameters.hint: The input LED terminal/junction capacitance at a stated frequency (usually f = 1 MHz), in farads (a printed pF is 1e-12). ~25-80 pF.

parameters.name: LED forward-voltage temperature coefficient
parameters.hint: The temperature drift of the LED forward voltage, in V/degC (a printed mV/degC or mV/K is 1e-3; per-K equals per-degC, same number). Typically negative, ~-1.5 to -1.7 mV/degC.

parameters.name: Input (LED) power dissipation (abs max)
parameters.hint: The maximum input-side (LED) power dissipation, in watts (a printed mW is 1e-3: 70 mW is 0.07). limitClass absolute_max.

parameters.name: Current transfer ratio (CTR)
parameters.hint: The marquee spec of a phototransistor/photodarlington output: output collector current divided by LED forward current, as a PERCENT (store the printed percent, e.g. 50-600, not the 0.5-6.0 ratio - vendors bin ranks as '80 to 160 %'). altUnit 1 for a sheet printing a bare ratio. Swept vs I_F (and vs T_A) - array over I_F and attach the V_CE and I_F conditions. Binned CTR ranks (A/B/C/D, GR/BL/...) are separate orderable grades - one document per grade, never fold the rank table into one array. A Darlington reaches 1000-6000 %; a logic/gate-drive/linear output has NO CTR.

parameters.name: Saturated current transfer ratio
parameters.hint: The CTR measured with the output transistor in saturation (at a low stated V_CE, e.g. 0.4 V), in percent. Attach the V_CE and I_F conditions.

parameters.name: Input threshold current
parameters.hint: The LED forward current that toggles a LOGIC-output coupler's gate to the on state, in amperes (a printed mA is 1e-3). The logic-output analogue of CTR - the transfer is a current threshold, not a ratio. Attach the output-load / VCC conditions.

parameters.name: Input current, output-off (max)
parameters.hint: The maximum LED current for which a LOGIC-output coupler's output stays high/off, in amperes (a printed uA is 1e-6: 250 uA is 2.5e-4). A recommended-operating bound on the off state.

parameters.name: LED trigger current
parameters.hint: The LED current that fires a PHOTO-TRIAC-DRIVER output, in amperes (a printed mA is 1e-3: 15 mA is 0.015). limitClass recommended (a max-to-guarantee-triggering value). Measured at a stated main-terminal voltage.

parameters.name: Transfer gain K3 (linear)
parameters.hint: The servo-to-forward gain ratio (K3 = K2/K1) of a LINEAR (servo-photodiode) coupler, dimensionless (~1, e.g. 0.85-1.15). This is the linear coupler's marquee - the near-unity, temperature-stable ratio that makes it usable for analog isolation. Vishay literally prints the unit column as 'K2/K1'. Attach the IPD / VPD conditions.

parameters.name: Servo gain K1 (linear)
parameters.hint: The input (servo) photodiode current per LED current (IPD1/IF) of a linear coupler, dimensionless (~0.005-0.015 as a bare ratio, or ~0.5 % - genuinely multi-unit: Vishay prints a bare ratio, Broadcom prints %). Attach the I_F / V_PD conditions.

parameters.name: Forward gain K2 (linear)
parameters.hint: The output (forward) photodiode current per LED current (IPD2/IF) of a linear coupler, dimensionless. Attach the I_F / V_PD conditions.

parameters.name: Transfer-gain nonlinearity (linear)
parameters.hint: The DC nonlinearity of a linear coupler's transfer, in percent (best-fit NLBF or ends-fit NLEF - keep which in conditionsVerbatim; ~0.01-0.25 % for a precision part like HCNR201). The spec that makes a linear coupler analog-grade. Attach the IPD range as a condition.

parameters.name: Transfer-gain temperature coefficient (linear)
parameters.hint: The temperature drift of a linear coupler's transfer gain K3, in ppm/degC (a printed %/degC is x1e4: 0.005 %/degC is 50 ppm/degC; a printed ppm/degC is stored as-is, e.g. -65). Per-K equals per-degC.

parameters.name: Input threshold voltage (logic/gate-drive)
parameters.hint: The input-pin forward voltage that guarantees a logic/gate-drive output stays off (VF(OFF)) or defines the H/L switch point (VFHL), in volts (~0.8 V). The voltage analogue of input_threshold_current - distinct from it (a current) and from input_current_off. Printed on gate-drive parts (TLP5754, ACNW3190).

parameters.name: Output open-circuit voltage (photovoltaic)
parameters.hint: The open-circuit output voltage of a PHOTOVOLTAIC MOSFET-driver output (VOM1271-class), in volts (~8 V at IF = 10 mA). Array over I_F. The photovoltaic output drives an external MOSFET gate - it carries no load itself (that would make it a solid_state_relay).

parameters.name: Output short-circuit current (photovoltaic)
parameters.hint: The short-circuit output current of a photovoltaic MOSFET-driver output, in amperes (a printed uA is 1e-6: 15 uA is 1.5e-5). Array over I_F - it sets the external-MOSFET gate turn-on speed.

parameters.name: Output photocurrent (linear)
parameters.hint: The photocurrent of a linear coupler's servo (IP1) or output (IP2) photodiode at a stated I_F, in amperes (a printed uA is 1e-6). Attach the I_F and V_PD/V_DET conditions.

parameters.name: Output photodiode leakage/dark current (linear)
parameters.hint: The dark/leakage current of a linear coupler's output photodiode at a stated reverse bias (Vdet), in amperes (a printed nA is 1e-9). Distinct from a phototransistor's collector_dark_current. Attach the V_DET condition.

parameters.name: Collector-emitter saturation voltage
parameters.hint: The saturated collector-emitter voltage of a phototransistor/Darlington output at a stated I_C and I_F, in volts (~0.1-0.2 V phototransistor, ~1.0-1.2 V Darlington - the double drop is a Darlington tell). Array over I_C; attach I_F.

parameters.name: Collector dark current
parameters.hint: The collector leakage current of a phototransistor/Darlington output with the LED off (IF = 0), at a stated V_CE, in amperes (a printed nA is 1e-9, uA is 1e-6). Rises strongly with temperature - array over T_A (e.g. 25 and 85 degC). Attach V_CE.

parameters.name: Collector-emitter voltage / breakdown
parameters.hint: The collector-emitter voltage rating (absolute_max) or breakdown (a min guarantee at a stated I_C), in volts (~35-80 V; a Darlington can be 300 V). Use limitClass to distinguish the abs-max rating from the characterized breakdown.

parameters.name: Emitter-collector voltage / breakdown
parameters.hint: The reverse (emitter-collector) voltage rating or breakdown of a phototransistor output, in volts (~6-7 V).

parameters.name: Collector-base breakdown voltage (base-pin part)
parameters.hint: The collector-base breakdown of a phototransistor output whose BASE pin is brought out (e.g. 4N35, 6-pin), in volts. Present only on base-out variants - the direct analogue of laser_diode's optional monitor_pd block.

parameters.name: Emitter-base breakdown voltage (base-pin part)
parameters.hint: The emitter-base breakdown of a base-out phototransistor output (e.g. 4N35), in volts (~7 V). Present only on base-out variants.

parameters.name: Collector current (abs max)
parameters.hint: The maximum output collector current of a phototransistor/Darlington output, in amperes (a printed mA is 1e-3: 50 mA is 0.05). limitClass absolute_max.

parameters.name: Collector (output) power dissipation (abs max)
parameters.hint: The maximum output-side (detector/collector) power dissipation, in watts (a printed mW is 1e-3: 150 mW is 0.15). limitClass absolute_max.

parameters.name: Output capacitance
parameters.hint: The output-element capacitance (collector-emitter for a phototransistor, photodiode for a linear coupler) at a stated frequency, in farads (a printed pF is 1e-12).

parameters.name: Output (detector) reverse voltage (abs max)
parameters.hint: The reverse-voltage abs-max rating of a linear/photodiode-output coupler's OUTPUT detector (IL300 output VR = 50 V), in volts. limitClass absolute_max. Distinct from the LED's input_reverse_voltage - do NOT alias bare `VR` (a datasheet uses VR for both input and output, disambiguated only by section).

parameters.name: Output surge current (triac driver, abs max)
parameters.hint: The peak (non-repetitive) surge on-state current of a photo-triac-driver OUTPUT, in amperes (~1 A, at a stated pulse width and rep rate). limitClass absolute_max. Distinct from the input LED's peak_forward_current (IFSM) - this is the output triac terminal.

parameters.name: Output-pin voltage (abs max)
parameters.hint: The absolute-max voltage on a logic/gate-drive output pin (6N137 VO = 7 V; TLP5754 VO = -0.5 to 35 V), in volts. limitClass absolute_max. A pin-stress rating distinct from the recommended supply_voltage (VCC) and from a phototransistor's collector_emitter_voltage. Where a sheet expresses it relative to VCC (VOH = VCC-4) that operating point is not an absolute volt - keep it verbatim, not here.

parameters.name: Low-level output voltage (logic)
parameters.hint: The logic-low output voltage of a LOGIC-output coupler at a stated sink current, in volts (~0.2-0.6 V). Attach the sink-current (I_OL/I_OUT) and VCC/IF conditions.

parameters.name: High-level output voltage (totem-pole logic)
parameters.hint: The logic-high output voltage of a TOTEM-POLE / push-pull logic output (e.g. TLP2361), in volts. Its presence (vs an output_high_current leakage + output_pullup_resistor) is what marks a totem-pole vs an open-collector/open-drain output.

parameters.name: High-level output current (open-collector leakage)
parameters.hint: The output leakage current of an OPEN-COLLECTOR/open-drain logic output in the high state, in amperes (a printed uA is 1e-6: 100 uA is 1e-4). Attach the VO and VCC conditions. An open-collector part pairs this with output_pullup_resistor; a totem-pole part instead prints output_high_voltage.

parameters.name: Output pull-up resistor (recommended)
parameters.hint: The recommended external pull-up resistor for an open-collector/open-drain logic output, in ohms (a printed kohm is 1e3: 350 ohm-4 kohm range). limitClass recommended.

parameters.name: Output supply voltage (recommended)
parameters.hint: The output-side supply voltage of a logic or gate-drive coupler, in volts (~4.5-5.5 V logic; 15-30 V gate-drive). A phototransistor/linear/triac coupler has no output-side supply. limitClass recommended (or absolute_max for the rating).

parameters.name: High-level supply current (logic)
parameters.hint: The output-side supply current with the output high (LED off), in amperes (a printed mA is 1e-3). Attach the VCC/VE conditions.

parameters.name: Low-level supply current (logic)
parameters.hint: The output-side supply current with the output low (LED on), in amperes (a printed mA is 1e-3). Attach the VCC/VE conditions. A single ICC value uses this key.

parameters.name: Enable input high threshold (logic)
parameters.hint: The high-level threshold of a logic coupler's output-enable pin, in volts (min ~2 V). Present only on parts with an enable/output-enable input.

parameters.name: Enable input low threshold (logic)
parameters.hint: The low-level threshold of a logic coupler's output-enable pin, in volts (max ~0.8 V).

parameters.name: Enable input current, high (logic)
parameters.hint: The enable-pin input current in the high state, in amperes (a printed uA/mA normalized; often negative, ~-0.2 to -1.6 mA). Attach the VE condition.

parameters.name: Enable input current, low (logic)
parameters.hint: The enable-pin input current in the low state, in amperes. Attach the VE condition.

parameters.name: Output fan-out (logic)
parameters.hint: The number of TTL loads a logic-output coupler can drive, a dimensionless count (e.g. 5). Recommended-operating.

parameters.name: Peak output source current (gate-drive)
parameters.hint: The peak SOURCE (turn-on) output current of a GATE-DRIVE output (HCPL-3120/ACNW3190-class), in amperes (~1-5 A). Attach the output-voltage condition (e.g. VO = VCC-4). Distinct from a logic output's uA-scale leakage IOH - a gate driver sources amps.

parameters.name: Peak output sink current (gate-drive)
parameters.hint: The peak SINK (turn-off) output current of a gate-drive output, in amperes (~1-5 A). Attach the output-voltage condition (e.g. VO = VEE+2.5).

parameters.name: Peak output current (gate-drive, abs max)
parameters.hint: The absolute-max peak output current of a gate-drive output (either direction), in amperes. limitClass absolute_max.

parameters.name: Output on-resistance (gate-drive)
parameters.hint: The on-state resistance of a gate-drive output stage (pull-up or pull-down), in ohms. Note: a gate driver's on-resistance drives an EXTERNAL gate - a part whose on-resistance carries the LOAD current is a solid_state_relay, a separate family.

parameters.name: UVLO threshold, rising (gate-drive)
parameters.hint: The rising (turn-on) under-voltage-lockout threshold of a gate-drive output supply, in volts (~11-13 V). Together with uvlo_threshold_falling defines the UVLO hysteresis.

parameters.name: UVLO threshold, falling (gate-drive)
parameters.hint: The falling (turn-off) under-voltage-lockout threshold of a gate-drive output supply, in volts (~9.5-11 V).

parameters.name: Off-state output voltage (triac driver, abs max)
parameters.hint: The peak off-state (blocking) voltage a PHOTO-TRIAC-DRIVER output withstands, in volts (~400-800 V). limitClass absolute_max. The triac driver only triggers an external triac - it does not carry the load.

parameters.name: On-state voltage (triac driver)
parameters.hint: The peak on-state voltage drop across a triac-driver output at a stated on-state current (either direction), in volts (~1.8-3 V). Attach the ITM condition.

parameters.name: Off-state leakage current (triac driver)
parameters.hint: The peak blocking (leakage) current of a triac-driver output at rated VDRM with the LED off, in amperes (a printed nA is 1e-9). Attach the V(off) condition.

parameters.name: Holding current (triac driver)
parameters.hint: The holding current of a triac-driver output (either direction), in amperes (a printed uA is 1e-6: 100 uA is 1e-4). Below this the triac output turns off.

parameters.name: Static dv/dt (triac driver)
aliases: critical rate of rise of off-state voltage
parameters.hint: The critical rate of rise of off-state voltage a triac-driver output withstands without false triggering, in V/us (a printed kV/us is x1e3). Often characterized (a curve, no guaranteed row) rather than a guaranteed value - set limitClass to characterized when it is curve-only. Distinct from CMTI (which is an isolation-barrier spec).

parameters.name: Zero-cross inhibit voltage (zero-cross triac driver)
parameters.hint: The main-terminal off-state voltage above which a ZERO-CROSS triac driver (MOC3063-class) inhibits triggering, in volts. Present only on zero-cross parts (note the note-only SWITCH = zero_cross condition); a random-phase driver omits it.

parameters.name: Isolation withstand voltage (VISO)
parameters.hint: The headline isolation withstand voltage (UL1577), in volts (~3750-5000 V). The printed 'Vrms' is a magnitude - store the number in V and set the measurement statistic to rms; keep 'AC, 1 min, 40-60% RH' in conditionsVerbatim. The one isolation spec on virtually every optocoupler. CONVENTION: store this single-value withstand in the `max` slot with limitClass absolute_max - a do-not-exceed rating, matching the diode VRRM precedent, so it is queryable on one bound across parts regardless of whether a given sheet's prose says 'maximum rated' or 'minimum withstand'.

parameters.name: Maximum working insulation voltage (VIORM)
parameters.hint: The maximum repetitive-peak working insulation voltage (IEC/EN 60747-5-5), in volts (~630-1414 Vpeak). Store the number in V with statistic peak; the standard/basis stays verbatim. The continuous-operation rating (VISO is a 1-minute withstand).

parameters.name: Transient isolation voltage (VIOTM)
parameters.hint: The highest allowable transient (impulse) isolation voltage (IEC 60747-5-5), in volts (~6000-10000 Vpeak). Store the number in V with statistic peak.

parameters.name: Surge isolation voltage (VIOSM)
parameters.hint: The surge (1.2/50 us impulse) isolation voltage of a reinforced-isolation part, in volts (Vpeak). Printed only on higher-grade parts (many parts print VIORM/VIOTM/VPR but no VIOSM). Store in V with statistic peak.

parameters.name: Partial-discharge test voltage (VPR)
parameters.hint: The partial-discharge test voltage (VIORM x 1.6 or x1.875, IEC 60747-5-5 method a/b), in volts (Vpeak). The pass criterion (PD < 5 pC) is a test-acceptance charge, NOT stored as a value - keep '< 5 pC' in conditionsVerbatim; the device value is this test voltage in V.

parameters.name: Isolation (input-output) resistance
parameters.hint: The DC resistance across the isolation barrier at a stated bias (usually 500 V) and temperature, in ohms (~1e11-1e14). Often given at 25 and 100 degC - array over T_A. Attach the V_S/V_IO bias condition.

parameters.name: Barrier (input-output) capacitance
parameters.hint: The capacitance across the isolation barrier at a stated frequency (usually 1 MHz), in farads (a printed pF is 1e-12: 0.6 pF is 6e-13). Sub-picofarad - it sets the common-mode coupling. Near-universal.

parameters.name: External creepage distance
parameters.hint: The shortest input-to-output distance along the package surface, in metres (a printed mm is 1e-3: 7 mm is 0.007). A safety-insulation distance - a legitimate `m` value (the metre also serves optical wavelength in other families; the key carries the distinction). Sets the pollution-degree/working-voltage rating.

parameters.name: External clearance distance
parameters.hint: The shortest input-to-output distance through air, in metres (a printed mm is 1e-3). A safety-insulation distance.

parameters.name: Internal insulation thickness (DTI)
parameters.hint: The internal insulation thickness between emitter and detector (distance through insulation), in metres (a printed mm is 1e-3: 0.4 mm is 4e-4). A safety-insulation distance; > 0.4 mm qualifies a part for reinforced insulation.

parameters.name: Comparative tracking index (CTI)
parameters.hint: The comparative tracking index (DIN IEC 112) - the max voltage the package material withstands without surface tracking, in volts (e.g. 175, >200; Broadcom prints 'CTI >200 V'). Canonical V; altUnit 1 for a sheet printing a bare index. Determines the material insulation group.

parameters.name: Safety-limiting input current (IS/ISI)
parameters.hint: The safety-limiting input current (60747-5-5 safety block), in amperes (a printed mA is 1e-3: 150 mA is 0.15). A single-fault safety limit.

parameters.name: Safety-limiting output power (PS/PSO)
parameters.hint: The safety-limiting output power (60747-5-5), in watts (a printed mW is 1e-3: 350 mW is 0.35).

parameters.name: Safety-limiting case temperature (TS)
parameters.hint: The safety-limiting case temperature (60747-5-5), in degC (~150-175). A single-fault safety limit distinct from the operating temperature range.

parameters.name: Output rise time
parameters.hint: The output rise time (10-90%) at a stated load, in seconds (a printed us is 1e-6, ns is 1e-9). Attach the R_L / C_L conditions.

parameters.name: Output fall time
parameters.hint: The output fall time (90-10%) at a stated load, in seconds. Attach the R_L / C_L conditions.

parameters.name: Turn-on time
parameters.hint: The output turn-on delay at a stated load, in seconds (a phototransistor ~us; a Darlington ~tens of us). Array-worthy when swept vs R_L. Attach R_L / VCC / IF.

parameters.name: Turn-off time
parameters.hint: The output turn-off delay at a stated load, in seconds. Attach R_L / VCC / IF.

parameters.name: Storage time
parameters.hint: The output storage time (a phototransistor/Darlington switching delay), in seconds. Attach the switching conditions.

parameters.name: Propagation delay to high output (logic/gate-drive)
aliases: propagation delay to high output level
propagation delay time to logic high
parameters.hint: The LED-to-output propagation delay to the high output level, in seconds (logic ~ns, gate-drive ~0.1-0.5 us). Attach the R_L/C_L (or R_G/C_G gate-load) and VCC conditions.

parameters.name: Propagation delay to low output (logic/gate-drive)
aliases: propagation delay to low output level
propagation delay time to logic low
parameters.hint: The LED-to-output propagation delay to the low output level, in seconds. Attach the load and VCC conditions.

parameters.name: Pulse-width distortion (logic)
parameters.hint: The pulse-width distortion |tPLH - tPHL| of a logic-output coupler, in seconds. Bounds the timing error a data stream accumulates.

parameters.name: Propagation delay skew (logic)
parameters.hint: The part-to-part propagation-delay skew of a logic-output coupler, in seconds - bounds skew across units in a multi-channel bus. Attach the load conditions.

parameters.name: Enable propagation delay (logic)
parameters.hint: The propagation delay from the output-enable pin to the output (VEH->VEL or VEL->VEH), in seconds. Present only on parts with an enable pin.

parameters.name: Cutoff frequency / bandwidth
parameters.hint: The -3 dB bandwidth of a phototransistor or linear-coupler output, in hertz (a printed kHz is 1e3, MHz is 1e6). ~80 kHz phototransistor, ~1-9 MHz linear. Attach the load conditions.

parameters.name: Data rate (logic)
parameters.hint: The maximum signaling rate of a high-speed logic-output coupler, in hertz (a printed MBd/Mbit/s is 1e6: 10 MBd is 1e7). MBd (baud) equals bit/s only for 1 bit/symbol (binary NRZ), which holds for these parts - keep 'MBd' in conditionsVerbatim.

parameters.name: Common-mode transient immunity (CMTI/CMR)
parameters.hint: The common-mode dV/dt across the barrier the output tolerates without a false transition, in V/us (a printed kV/us is x1e3: 15 kV/us is 15000; a printed V/us is stored as-is - 1000 V/us is 1000, NOT converted). Usually specified for both output states (|CMH| high, |CML| low) - array over the note-only OUTPUT_STATE axis. Attach the common-mode voltage V_CM (e.g. 1000 V or 1500 V) as a condition - it varies across vendors and is load-bearing. An isolation-barrier transient-slew spec; distinct from the static dB rejection ratio common_mode_rejection_ratio and from a triac driver's static_dv_dt.

parameters.name: Common-mode rejection ratio (CMRR/IMRR)
parameters.hint: The static common-mode rejection ratio of a linear/analog-isolation coupler (a linear coupler names the isolation-mode form IMRR), in dB at a stated low frequency (typically 60 Hz). A linear-coupler headline (IL300 100 dB, HCNR201 IMRR 95 dB). Distinct from the V/us common_mode_transient_immunity - do NOT store a dB rejection ratio there.

parameters.name: Operating temperature range
parameters.hint: The operating (ambient) temperature range, in degC. Model as a min and max on one measurement.

parameters.name: Storage temperature range
parameters.hint: The storage temperature range, in degC. limitClass absolute_max.

parameters.name: Junction temperature (abs max)
parameters.hint: The maximum junction temperature, in degC. limitClass absolute_max.

parameters.name: Soldering / reflow temperature (abs max)
parameters.hint: The maximum soldering/reflow temperature at a stated dwell, in degC (~260). limitClass absolute_max; keep the dwell (e.g. 10 s) verbatim.

parameters.name: Total package power dissipation (abs max)
parameters.hint: The maximum total package power dissipation (input + output), in watts (a printed mW is 1e-3: 200 mW is 0.2). limitClass absolute_max. The mW/degC derating slope is derivable from this plus the derating onset (kept verbatim), not stored.
